note: Canonical merge contract for solutions progress. This file is the single source: docs-site tests/fixtures/solutions-progress-merge.json and docs-ui tests/solution-progress/fixtures/merge-vectors.json are byte-identical copies. Edit here, copy verbatim; both test suites run every vector.
rules: Document shape, v2: {v:2, updatedAt, solutions:{<id>:{steps:{<stepId>:{done, at}}, currentStep, startedAt, updatedAt, completedAt, solutionVersion}}}. Timestamps are epoch milliseconds (numbers) on the wire and in storage; ISO 8601 strings are accepted on input and normalized to numbers. Output is always v2.

v1 input is still accepted (migrate on read): a record with no `steps` object has its `completedSteps` list (deduplicated in first-seen order, invalid ids dropped, the last 100 kept) turned into {done:true, at:<that record updatedAt>} entries. When `steps` is an object, `completedSteps` is ignored.
Each vector is merge(existing, incoming) evaluated at clock `now`. docs-site calls mergeAll(stored, clientBody); docs-ui calls merge(remote, local), so its local copy is `incoming`.

Normalization before merging: solution ids and step ids must match /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,62}[a-z0-9])?$/; a step entry must be an object with a boolean `done`, else it is dropped; an unusable step `at` becomes 0; currentStep must be a valid step id else null; solutionVersion must match /^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/ else null; unusable timestamps become null, except updatedAt which becomes 0; unknown keys are dropped.
Clamp: any timestamp later than now + 5 minutes becomes now + 5 minutes.

Steps: per step id over the union of both sides, the entry with the greater `at` wins; on equal `at`, done:true wins. An un-mark is {done:false, at} and is kept, never deleted. The rule ignores which side is existing or incoming, so it is commutative.
Step cap: at most 100 entries (done or not) per record, keeping the greatest `at` first, ties by id ascending. Step keys are emitted in id order.
Per solution: the record with the greater updatedAt is `later`, the other `earlier`. On a tie the incoming record is `later`.
updatedAt = max(a.updatedAt, b.updatedAt). startedAt = min of the non-null values (null only when both are null).
currentStep = later.currentStep, falling back to earlier.currentStep when null. solutionVersion follows the same rule.

completedAt = the earliest non-null value, except: null when both solutionVersions are set and differ (the completion no longer applies to the current step list), and null when any step in the merged record is {done:false} with `at` later than that completedAt (a step was un-marked after the completion). The same un-mark check applies when a single record is normalized.
Solutions present on only one side are kept unchanged after normalization.
Document updatedAt = max(existing.updatedAt, incoming.updatedAt, every merged record updatedAt); 0 for an empty document.
After merging, keep at most 50 solutions, evicting the smallest updatedAt first (ties by id), then keep evicting until the serialized document is at most 32768 bytes.
The `invalid` cases are client bodies the strict validator rejects (HTTP 400). The stored side is read leniently: bad keys and records are dropped, the rest kept.
